name: Nigeria
hook: Africa's densest women's-health-tech ecosystem: strong on policy, starved of dedicated venture capital.

name: Kenya
hook: One of the continent's deepest ecosystems, home to Kasha and Jacaranda Health's 2.9M-mother PROMPTS.

name: South Africa
hook: Mature health-tech and SRH market anchored by MomConnect, with a small but fast-growing femtech scene.

name: Rwanda
hook: State-built infrastructure, Kasha, Zipline blood drones and HPV elimination, makes it a standout hub.

name: Morocco
hook: AI diagnostics lead: DeepEcho won US FDA clearance for AI fetal ultrasound and a national MoH pilot.

name: Cote d'Ivoire
hook: Home of Janngo Capital, Africa's largest gender-equal tech VC fund, plus a big public-health push.

name: Ghana
hook: Government-led menstrual and maternal health push, with dedicated femtech funding still thin.

name: Egypt
hook: Small but distinctive Arabic-language femtech, led by MotherBeing and menstrual health apps.

name: Uganda
hook: Maternal and reproductive health innovation around Kampala, largely grant-funded.

name: Tanzania
hook: National maternal transport and menstrual health enterprises lead a mostly grant-driven ecosystem.

name: Zambia
hook: Dawa Health's AI DawaMom platform anchors a grant-driven, civil-society-heavy ecosystem.

name: Ethiopia
hook: State-run digital community health (eCHIS) plus YeneHealth, the country's first femtech startup.

name: Zimbabwe
hook: Local AI maternal tools like Tariro's MamaBot, plus digitised maternal death surveillance.

name: Senegal
hook: Francophone West Africa's digital-health leader, with unusually visible gender-lens capital.

name: Malawi
hook: mHealth, drone logistics and menstrual social enterprises over VC-backed startups.
